setup: Install TestFlight from the App Store first.
account: a fresh Apple ID with notifications allowed
what: Plantpal tells you which houseplant needs water today.
start: Open the TestFlight invite, tap Install, then open Plantpal.
controls: Tap to open, swipe left on a plant to mark it watered.
learn: Whether the Today list is the first thing you want every morning.
quirks: The first photo can take a few seconds to upload.
